async def act(page):
    # Click on the Catalog link in the menubar to access catalog options
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog").click()
    # Wait for the catalog menu to load or expand
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Click on the Products link under Catalog (assuming it appears after clicking Catalog)
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Products").click()
    # Wait for the products page to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Click on the button to add a new product (likely 'Add Product' button)
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add Product").click()
    # Wait for the product creation page to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Select 'Simple Product' type if presented (might be a dropdown or button)
    # Assuming it's a button or link with name 'Simple Product'
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Simple Product").click()
    # Wait for the product form to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Fill in the product name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Product Name").fill("Lelelumon Yoga Mat")
    # Fill in the price
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price").fill("769.99")
    # Set stock quantity to 42
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Quantity").fill("42")
    # Set size to uni-size (assuming a dropdown or text field)
    # Use select_option if it's a <select> element, otherwise fill
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option("uni-size")
    # Set color to black
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option("black")
    # Save the product
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
